## Story DD Coverage
DD7: docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml exists with ≥3 source entries documenting where corpus content originates.

## Context
The provenance file lives at project root docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml (not inside plugins/dso/). It documents the external sources used to populate the reference corpus so future maintainers know where entries originated.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File exists at docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml
- [ ] ≥3 source entries, each with: name, url, license, notes fields
- [ ] Entries include at minimum: USWDS, GOV.UK Design System, VA.gov Design System
- [ ] Valid YAML syntax

## Given/When/Then
GIVEN a developer adds a new corpus entry
WHEN they consult docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml
THEN they can identify the source URL and license for any entry origin
